newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing ITIC sets US$30 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Beijing ITIC sets US$30 mln loan.

text.p: Beijing International Trust and Investment Corp's US$30 million term loan facility has been launched into general syndication, bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the facility has a final maturity of 364 days with a lenders option to extend for another 364 days.
It pays an interest margin of 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Repayment is in bullet form. The availability period is 60 days.
Fees are 45 basis points for lead managers committing US$5 million or more and 42.5 basis points for co-lead managers committing $3 million to $4 million.
Proceeds are to be used for general working capital.
Societe Generale Asia is the sole arranger.
